h1: Weight loss, with a doctor in your corner.
lede: Sustainable weight loss starts with a plan built around your health, habits, and goals. Dr. Khan combines nutrition, activity, and medication when appropriate, with ongoing follow-up as your needs change.
glance: A physician-led program that starts with your history, not a fad diet.

basics.heading: How the program works
paras: It starts with your medical history and the diets you have tried before, plus a nutritional assessment to check for deficiencies and build a balanced meal plan you can live with.

Based on your health history and goals, Dr. Khan may recommend medication or supplements when clinically appropriate. These are paired with nutrition and activity changes rather than used on their own.
Progress is tracked at follow-up visits and the plan changes as you do. For stubborn areas, body contouring can complement the program.

faq: When it is appropriate for your health and goals, yes. Medication is always combined with a nutrition and activity plan.
Can I combine weight loss with body contouring?
Yes. Many patients add SmartLipo, CoolSculpting, or Kybella for areas that do not respond to diet and exercise.
